summary: Separate English and Spanish first-party discovery was completed. Monclova municipal Catastro and the Coahuila IRYC/state registry services are evidenced as local/state custodians, including a Monclova office and cadastral-plan/cartography procedures. No safe anonymous parcel map/API, native parcel ID plus geometry response, schema, or CRS was verified; runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Exact English and Spanish query text, outcomes, and actual URLs are recorded in city-6107-monclova.json.
requestOutcomes: TLS-verified public GET/search checks retrieved the municipal Catastro page, municipal Predial portal, state IRYC page, state cadastral-service catalogue, public-registry office directory, and an INEGI cartographic lead. The Predial direct route returned HTTP 406 from nginx/ModSecurity; it is an account-number payment/consultation form and was not probed with unsafe data. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA bypass, unsafe query, or TLS-verification bypass was used.
